notes: The booklet has two minifigs (Squidman and a Space Police pilot) plus one vehicle (a hover bike) built in 12 steps, including a rear sub-assembly built on page 9–10. Squidman is built on page 2. The banknote tile is shown held by his hand.

Element IDs come from the inventory page. Part types other than 379401 and 302221 were not in the catalogue, so they are defined as new types. Grey-looking pieces are shown with colour props from the inventory art.
Page 3 step 2 is ambiguous. I read it as a second black 2x4 plate (b2) stacked on b1, with white clip plate 4515337 (b3) on the exposed studs at the rear end.
In steps 3–4 two white Technic 1x4 bricks (4143254) sit side by side on the plate. The 1x2 Technic brick 3200001 goes at the front.
The two blue pins hold the green engine cones. The side-hole joints are modelled as insert and push-on.
Wedges 6x2 (steps 7 and 8) are attached to the body bricks b4 and b5. The exact stud positions can't be seen in the pictures. The grilles and stickers sit on the wedges.

Where the cockpit pieces (b18–b21) sit on the grey plate b9 is my best reading of step 9. The red and blue 1x1 slopes are the light bar, and the 1x2 stud plate 379401 carries the blue slope. The flag clips onto the two handle plates b10 and b11, and the handlebar clips onto the black clip plate b21.

Rear unit (page 9–10): black 2x2, white handle plate, nub clip piece and red 2x2 plate are stacked. The two black bracket plates and two white 4x2 wedges follow. The unit is flipped over between steps 3 and 4. In step 11 its nub clip plugs into the clip plate b3 at the rear of the vehicle.
In step 12 the police pilot sits on the vehicle. I joined his legs to the grey plate b9 and put his hands in contact with the handlebar. The real stud position is not clear.
Stickers are not physical parts and are not nodes.
